        + (Complex.digamma (1 / 4 + (parity χ.primitiveCharacter : ℂ) / 2 + I * r / 2)).re :=

items.words: a finite sum of configurations over a Finset
Weil positivity of the finite sum holds exactly when it holds for every summand
the configurations of the primitive characters χ ≠ 1 of conductor dividing q
Weil positivity of the summed configuration holds exactly when the TARGET of every χ in the family holds
the conductor entering once per summand as log(N/π), printed from the summed arithmetic side
One concrete modulus instantiated by rfl or decide
the trivial character's instance is ζ's (with the pole)
